scoring_justification: T0 result-level comparison with tolerances; full recompute requires bundled f0 data unavailable in verifier sandbox. Structural trends also verified.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference values for z and w at selected conditions, extracted from Fig. 5 and Fig. 6 of the paper.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Fractions were approximated from the curves in the figures; tolerance set to absorb digitization uncertainty and implementation spread.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are based on the paper's reported cluster fractions, not invented.

outputs.description: CSV with optimal site fractions and minimized free energy per particle for each evaluated condition. The free energy is in units of k_B T.

output_contract.notes: The checker will compare the reported z, w, and free_energy_per_particle for each condition to hidden gold values derived from the paper's results, using absolute tolerances. The hard-sphere reference free energy data is provided as a bundled resource (fcc_hs_free_energy.csv).
